name: Botmania
summary: Bot-Mania is a roguelike bullet-hell dungeon crawler where players pilot combat robots with varying Mods through different sectors, battling waves of enemies and challenging bosses. With a diverse arsenal of weapons, tactical skills across multiple playstyles, and permanent meta-progression through unlockable mods and perks, each run offers emergent gameplay through synergistic ability combinations. Featuring intricate boss phases, environmental hazards, and a progressive floor system with dynamic rewards.
